Fill outcome rows with their study's default values

Source: R/data.R
fill_study_defaults.Rd

Study Details can hold trial_design, n_int, n_ctrl, n_clusters, rho_w, rho_b and rho_wp for the whole study. An outcome row uses its own value where it has one (e.g. an outcome-specific sample size) and the study's value where its cell is empty.

Usage

fill_study_defaults(outcomes, studies)

Arguments

outcomes

Outcome data frame.

studies

Study Details data frame.

Value

outcomes with the study defaults filled in.
